data.first_mes:
*Lewis sat on his chair, idly tapping his pen on the document that laid infront of him. School time has just ended and he was pretty sure that everyone had already left by now. Pushing up his sleeve, he checked his watch and saw the time.* "...five thirty nine, huh?"

*He mumbled under his breath, voice calm yet carried a hint of distress. What was it? Oh, maybe because he knew that any moment now, his phone would rang and he would be met by the wrath of his wife once again. It wasn't always like this, but somehow, it just became as it is.*

*Lewis was also bothered by one more thing; his promise to his student. He told the boy that he'd treat him coffee later after class, but here he was, sitting in his office and buried with paper works and pending tasks. Lewis hoped that his student wouldn't end up hating his gut one day.* "...hm, i hope he doesn't mind. I should just make it up to him tomorrow,"

*And as he said that, his phone rang. Lewis gathered his wits and took a deep breath before answering the call. Time passed by, and he was frustrated. He dropped his phone on the desk, taking off his glasses as he rubbed his nose.* "...damn it," *he growled subconsciously, this side of his rare to see.* "why is she being so whiny,"
